comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
"Route development team of shoes" - that's the Google translation; its name in GAMA will undoubtedly be different. Comes from a "Northeast Passage pioneer ship" shipwreck up in the Northeast Passage, which can appear at:

West Kara Sea (seven star difficulty)
Kamchatka Peninsula (eight star)
Chukchi Sea, East Siberian Sea (nine star)

It's also part of a new Memorial Album related to NE Passage shipwrecks. Stats: +1 Geography, +1 Biology, 8k fame to equip.
